top_signals.title: JLL on Asia's Commercial Property Sector
top_signals.summary: Pamela Ambler, Head of APAC Investor Intelligence at JLL, discusses the outlook for commercial real estate industry in Hong Kong and the rest of the Asia Pacific region. She speaks with David Ingles and Avril Hong on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)
